ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( AND( ISCHANGED(Phase__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Phase__c, 'A - Application Recieved')), NOT($User.Division = "Exam Branch"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "RNEW - Renewal")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type__c, "RSTR - Restore - No A/I Status")), CompleteApplicationBy__c >= TODAY(), LicenseType__r.DateofBirthRequiredonApplication__c = true, ISBLANK( Birthdate__c ), TEXT(MethodofLicensure__c) <> "LC - Licensure Compact" ), true, false )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This License Type requires the Birthdate field to be populated before it can be moved out of the A Phase.
